_comment: smtp-proxy-rs uses the GENERATED repo-infra standard: ci.yml, changelog.yml,
.github/workflows/lib/ all come out of the assembler. Do not hand-edit them;
take the newer set instead, or the next `apply` reverts you silently.
The ONE deliberate exception is the publish-deb-container add-on job in
release-publish.yml, and the `needs:` line on `finalize` that waits for it.
Both are commented at the top of that file. Read them before running `apply`.
The static musl build is NOT a local edit: it is the opt-in ci-rust-musl
block named below, so it joins the required ci-passed check.
